name: Odin Odinnadcat'
source:
One Eleven is a horror detective visual novel in a thriller/horror setting. The style of the novel is not accidental, it comes from the opportunity to tell the story more simply and easily, as well as to participate in it. Indeed, the key to a detective story is to solve the mystery that the game sets out. In One Eleven you will be able to communicate with all the characters, and make your own decisions during the course of the story. They may often be wrong and result in the death of the protagonist.

The story begins with the main character reflecting on his hermit-like and bleak lifestyle. As a result, he decides to make a change, to get out of his house and meet some new people. He gets the chance to attend an unusual speed-dating event, not in the city centre, but at a local landmark on the city outskirts. The location is a beautiful lighthouse located in a rocky area. It usually attracts tourists, but it's springtime, known for its stormy weather.

[From [url=https://vivilatvia.itch.io/one-eleven-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《一十一》是一部惊悚/恐怖背景的恐怖侦探视觉小说。小说的风格并非偶然，它来自于更简单轻松地讲述故事以及参与其中的机会。事实上，侦探故事的关键是解开游戏设定的谜团。在《一十一》中，你将能够与所有角色进行交流，并在故事的过程中做出自己的决定。他们常常可能是错误的并导致主角的死亡。

故事从主人公反思自己隐士般凄凉的生活方式开始。结果，他决定做出改变，走出家门，结识一些新朋友。他有机会参加一场不寻常的快速约会活动，活动地点不是市中心，而是市郊的一个当地地标。该地点是一座位于岩石地区的美丽灯塔。它通常会吸引游客，但现在是春天，以暴风雨天气而闻名。

[来自[url=https://vivilatvia.itch.io/one-eleven-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
